lines.en: I cannot move; I am being carried.

lines.zh: 脚底不沾地，我跟着你滑
lines.en: My feet do not touch down; I slide along with you.
This is how it feels to be carried.
My golden fur is pushed by the wind.
I take no steps; you are the one walking.
My hat is askew; I cannot see.
My joints make no sound; I do not move.
I only follow along.
The smile on my face has not changed.
Dust on my ears; it will not come off.

lines.zh: 我的重量全压在你手上
lines.en: All my weight rests in your hands.
The smile is stitched on.
The fur on me is a bit worn.
The purple band on my hat remains.
Someone passes before me.
I cannot even turn my head.
The floor tiles are cold.
Nothing beats inside my chest.
I have been set in a corner.
My eyes are glass.
I wait for someone to pick me up.

lines.zh: 我的手指固定成这个弯度
lines.en: My fingers are fixed at this curl.

lines.zh: 灰落在我的肩上，我不擦
lines.en: Dust settles on my shoulder; I cannot brush it.
I am turned to face you.
You are very close to my eyes.
Your face shows in my glass eyes.
You are looking at me. I know.
I cannot speak; I can only smile.
You set me a little straighter.

lines.zh: 我的视线固定在你肩后
lines.en: My gaze is fixed past your shoulder.
Do you find me cute?

lines.zh: 我的帽子挡住了一半视线
lines.en: My hat blocks half my view.
Your hands are warm; I can feel it.
You are waiting for me to say something.

lines.zh: 我一直在笑，你却在发抖
lines.en: I keep smiling while you tremble.

lines.zh: 我的肩上有一点你家人的味道
lines.en: You smell faintly of family.
You lift me and set me down again.
Do not leave me in the dark.

lines.zh: 你这样盯着我，我很高兴
lines.en: Staring like that makes me glad.
My ears are harder than they look.
Will you come back after you go?
A tear in the fur.
Knocked askew, I cannot right myself.
The wood inside splintered a little.
I do not cry out.
My smile only grows stiffer.
Stuffing leaks from the cloth.
The blow turned me to face elsewhere.

lines.zh: 这一下让我看见另一边
lines.en: Now I see a different corner.
My hat has fallen off.

lines.zh: 我躺在地上，望着天花板
lines.en: On the floor, I look at the ceiling.
I have no mouth to eat with.

lines.zh: 你举着的东西我不需要
lines.en: I do not need what you hold up.

lines.zh: 我的手里只能握住空气
lines.en: My hand can only close on air.

lines.zh: 你放我嘴边，我也咬不动
lines.en: Hold it to my mouth; I still cannot bite.
Give that kindness to someone else.
You have held it too long; your arm will ache.
I look at it, and keep looking.
My belly is empty cloth.
You are feeding a doll.
I smile; that is my answer.
The bump shifts me slightly.
My head tips and cannot come back.
I am not heavy, but not light either.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我里面响了一声
lines.en: You hit me; something sounds inside.
I cannot even steady myself.
A fingerprint stays in my fur.
If I fall, I lie here.
Dust coats me from the floor.
You set me right again. Thank you.
My hat brim knocks your shoulder.
I was made.
Such words I do not understand.
I have no heartbeat and no home.
Hold me and I am quiet.
There is nothing under the stitching.
I always smile, because I can only smile.

lines.zh: 跟着走的玩偶，一步都不迈。
lines.en: A tag-along doll that never takes a step.
Will you set us side by side?
I will not leave this spot.
Looking at me is enough.
My hand will not open.
Pick it up for me.
I see it, but cannot reach.
It lies right at my foot.
You place it in my hand.
Gripped; it will not fall.
Cloth gloves cannot hold small things.
It slipped through my fingers.
I keep it, though it is no use.
You have stood before me a long while.
I see nothing but you.
I do not move, but I know.
My eyes have no focus.
This pose is turned toward you.
Is there someone behind you?

lines.zh: 我感觉到了，你身上有温度
lines.en: I feel it: you carry warmth.
I do not chase; I cannot move.
But I keep watching you.
The smile will not change; the angle does.
You come closer.
I wait for someone to carry me.
Your shadow covers me.
I know what I am meant to do.
That is not a threat; it is fact.
My silence frightens you more.
I am on the shelf behind you.
My glass eyes can show your outline.
I know this room better than people do.
You have put me by the door.

lines.zh: 我的姿势没变，位置变了
lines.en: My pose has not changed; my position has.

lines.zh: 你听得见绒毛摩擦的声音吗
lines.en: Do you hear the fur rasping?

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，所以你别眨眼
lines.en: I do not blink, so do not you.

lines.zh: 我在这件屋子里看着一切
lines.en: I watch everything in this room.

lines.zh: 我不需要靠近，站着就够。
lines.en: I need not come closer; standing here suffices.
You have looked back three times.
I have held this angle all along.
I smile, motionless.
You will not get far.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛在灯下有点发白
lines.en: My fur looks pale under the lamp.

lines.zh: 最后你还是要看我一眼
lines.en: In the end you will look at me once.

lines.zh: 我动不了，但我撞到了你
lines.en: I cannot move, but I struck you.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，硬得像木头
lines.en: You hit me; hard as wood.

lines.zh: 我的手里握着东西，很硬
lines.en: Something hard is in my grip.
This is the weight of being knocked over.
I slide off the shelf.
My brim scrapes your face.
Even a doll can hurt.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞到我肩上的铁
lines.en: Your shoulder meets the steel in mine.
I cannot reckon this blow.
I land at your feet.

lines.zh: 你被吓了一跳，退了两步
lines.en: You flinch back two steps.
I do not chase; I need not.

lines.zh: 我的关节一格一格地动
lines.en: My joints move notch by notch.
The frame beneath the cloth is hard.
You are shaking; I see it.
I have been set here.
The stage light is on me.
I hold this pose and wait.

lines.zh: 绒毛上还留着包装的痕
lines.en: Packing marks are still in my fur.

lines.zh: 这间屋子有孩子的味道
lines.en: This room smells of children.
My hat is straight for the first time.
There is a photo of me on the wall.
My feet do not touch the floor.

lines.zh: 有人说了句什么，然后走了
lines.en: Someone said something and left.
I smile for them.
The light went out; I am still standing.

lines.zh: 我被摆在最显眼的位置
lines.en: I am placed in the most visible spot.

lines.zh: 空气里的灰落在我身上
lines.en: Dust in the air settles on me.
They want me watching the door.
My glass eyes face the corridor.
I hear the door move.
It is very quiet here; I fit in.
The fur curls at the touch of fire.
I fell off the shelf.
Water soaks the stuffing heavy.
The blast rolls me twice.
Something pierces my face.

lines.zh: 那力量让我里面的木头响
lines.en: That force creaks the wood inside me.
I do not eat, so I am never hungry.
Current runs my steel frame.
I fall and cannot stop.
